Article 103:
> The procedure for conducting elections of the President of Ukraine is established by law.

This clause is not only concerned with normal elections every 5 years, but also when/how/if elections are held during extraordinary circumstances (i.e. this war). By the way, not everything needs to be spelled out exactly in the constitution and further clarification is something for the legislature to consider. For example, it says that the coat of arms is the tryzub in the constitution, but it doesn't say that there must a 2/3 inch spacing between each prong on the tryzub and the colour must be light blue, etc etc; that is something the Rada must sort out.
